title: Shared Gallery
tagline: Every moment becomes part of the whole.
shortDescription: One gallery for every photo and video of the event: guests scan a code, upload from their phone, and see everyone's moments together, on their phone and on screens around the venue.
longDescription: A shared, browsable gallery that collects photos and videos from guests' phones, photo booths, photographers, and games into one place. Guests scan a QR code and upload straight from the browser, with no app and no login, then browse the gallery or download what they like. The same collection can run live on screens around the venue, be split into albums by team, theme, or moment, and stay online after the event as a lasting memory. Branding, moderation, albums, and download options are configurable. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: No App, No Login
highlights.description: Guests scan, upload, and browse in seconds from any phone, so far more people share their photos than with a hashtag or an email address.

highlights.title: A Hundred Viewpoints, One Gallery
highlights.description: Every guest sees the event from a different angle. Together, their photos tell a story no single photographer could capture.

highlights.title: Lives On After the Event
highlights.description: The gallery stays online, can be downloaded as one file, and keeps the brand in front of guests long after they have gone home.

highlights.title: More Ways to Collect
highlights.description: Add a written or video guestbook, albums for each stage or team, a moderation step before images go public, or a photo challenge with themed prompts.

highlights.title: A Gallery for Every Occasion
highlights.description: Turn it into a wedding album, a conference highlights wall, a festival memory book, or a museum wall of visitor perspectives.

highlights.title: Reach You Can Count
highlights.description: Add a data layer that counts uploads, viewers, downloads, and shares, and pair it with an opt-in step so every upload can also build the guest list for the next event.

highlights.title: The Memory Layer
highlights.description: Pair with Memory Catcher and Connected Photographer to fill the gallery automatically, with Live Feed to show the best moments on screens, or with Journey Recap to send each guest their own selection.
